scope: All 192 changed sites in the 193-site minimum/lower-bound family: 172 at-least adverbs and 20 least-common-multiple adjectives; one existing prinajmenje control retained.
choice: Render lower bounds as official prinajmenje and the exact technical phrase least common multiple as najmenše obće mnogokratno.
motivation: German and mathematical syntax separate mindestens/wenigstens from kleinstes gemeinsames Vielfaches. A single spelling substitution would collapse two meanings and leave the LCM adjective without agreement.
alternatives_rejected: Global prinajmenje would corrupt 20 LCM terms.
Global najmenje would misrender lower bounds.
Retaining najmanje/najmene/najmenej preserves three national surface strata.
